title: OPTDRV-002: Andor shutdown destroys the static global `driver_mutex` inside the per-device loop after using it for the current device
summary: OPTDRV-002: Andor shutdown destroys the static global `driver_mutex` inside the per-device loop after using it for the current device. With multiple cameras, the next iteration locks a destroyed mutex; after one shutdown/init cycle, future SDK operations can also use an invalid mutex. Do not destroy this static process-lifetime mutex per camera. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.
